name: POMGNT1-related Limb-Girdle Muscular Dystrophy R15

ethnicAssociations: Reported in multiple ethnicities including European and Middle Eastern populations

diagnosticCriteria.formalCriteriaName: Diagnostic criteria for POMGNT1-related LGMD R15

criteria.description: Progressive proximal muscle weakness predominantly affecting limb-girdle muscles
Muscle biopsy showing dystrophic changes with reduced or abnormal glycosylation of alpha-dystroglycan
Identification of biallelic pathogenic variants in the POMGNT1 gene
Mild to moderate elevation of serum creatine kinase levels
Brain MRI showing cobblestone lissencephaly or other structural abnormalities in some cases

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Presence of progressive proximal muscle weakness with confirmatory muscle biopsy findings and identification of biallelic pathogenic POMGNT1 variants
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Genetic confirmation is essential for definitive diagnosis; clinical presentation may overlap with other dystroglycanopathies.

pathognomonic.notes: Detected via immunohistochemistry or western blot on muscle biopsy
searchTerms: defective sugar modification of muscle protein
abnormal sugar attachment on muscle protein

occasional.symptomName: Ocular abnormalities including myopia and strabismus
searchTerms: eye problems including nearsightedness and crossed eyes
difficulty breathing due to muscle weakness

laboratory: Hypoglycosylation of alpha-dystroglycan on muscle biopsy
imaging: Brain MRI may show cobblestone lissencephaly or other cortical malformations
Muscle MRI showing fatty replacement and muscle atrophy in proximal muscles
other: Muscle biopsy revealing dystrophic features and abnormal glycosylation

distinguishingFeatures: Prominent brain malformations with severe intellectual disability
Mutations in the same gene but distinct clinical phenotype
Similar muscle involvement but different genetic cause

redFlags: Rapidly progressive proximal muscle weakness in childhood
Presence of brain malformations on neuroimaging
references: Mercuri E, et al. Limb-girdle muscular dystrophies. Nat Rev Dis Primers. 2019.
Godfrey C, et al. Refining genotype-phenotype correlations in muscular dystrophies caused by POMGNT1 mutations. Neurology. 2007.
